content: Add a transport-only bridge that consumes one QmpSocket lifecycle reply and submits the already-captured event through QmpLifecycleAdapter and Coordinator, preserving pending state for unrelated wire events and keeping socket errors separate from lifecycle authority.

Content revision a41a4a9ee1a0d4c8fa72f1b4759a3c5a96d9016c adds QmpLifecycleSocketOutcome and QmpLifecycleAdapter::receive_and_submit, updates the vfio-user boundary documentation and W0122 plan, and adds socketpair coverage for correlated success, wrong-kind pending, malformed, and closed-socket paths. The content commit was created with Agent Harness (codex) as Author and Committer.

Focused QMP socket bridge regression passed 1/1. The .#vulkan-runtime configure/build and full CTest preset passed 91/91, including all existing transport, lifecycle, provider, architecture, and stress tests; git diff --check passed. Checkpoint P20260831-086 records the socket-to-Coordinator boundary and leaves producer-wide reset/restart wiring, provider freeze, and live qualification open.

Closed the coherent W0122 socket lifecycle bridge stage at checkpoint P20260831-086. No session-owned disposable route or repository-local build output was created; external build trees remain under their existing owner, and foreign guidance inboxes remain with S01322/S01323.
